item_name: Rothco USMC Eagle, Globe, and Anchor Pullover Hooded Sweatshirt
item_short_desc: Showcase your support for the United States Marine Corps in comfortable military style with our USMC Eagle, Globe, and Anchor Pullover Hooded Sweatshirt! The hoodie jacket is a great outer layer for morning jogs, outdoor exercise routines, daily use, and more.
description: Showcase your support for the United States Marine Corps in comfortable military style with our USMC Eagle, Globe, and Anchor Pullover Hooded Sweatshirt! This rugged sweatshirt features the Eagle, Globe, and Anchor insignia underneath the boldly outlined “USMC” text, and is officially licensed by the United States Marine Corps. The hoodie jacket is a great outer layer for morning jogs, outdoor exercise routines, daily use, and more. Stay Cool & Dry: Made of 100% polyester, these workout hoodies wick sweat and moisture away for optimum comfort. Featuring our rapid moisture control fabric, sweat is swiftly transferred to the top layer, allowing for a quick dry. This prevents sweat from soaking through the moisture-wicking hoodie and back into your undershirt, allowing you to move freely without your clothing sticking to you. Pullover Warmth & Utility: With a soft microfleece lining, these pullover hooded sweatshirts provide all-day comfort. The drawstring hood keeps your head and neck warm while protecting you against cold wind and rain. The elastic wrist cuffs keep the sleeves in place while providing a snug fit for additional insulation. Large Front Kangaroo Pocket: These hoody sweatshirts also feature a lined front pocket that’s ideal for hand warming. The kangaroo pocket doubles as a convenient place to carry your phone, keys, water bottle, or other small everyday carry items. Perfect Fit for Everyone: These durable and long-lasting hoodies are a great fit for anyone. This is the one hooded sweatshirt you’ll want to keep nearby, and perhaps keep an extra, just in case.
